title: UEREMCP Common Definitions
description: Shared primitive definitions referenced by all UEREMCP schemas. Frozen by ADR-0003. Owned by WS-01 only.

protocolVersion.description: Major.minor. A mismatched MAJOR is rejected, never best-effort parsed (ADR-0003).

requestId.description: Client-supplied correlation id, echoed on the response. A UUID is conventional but any stable string is accepted.

assetPath.description: Unreal package path, e.g. /Game/VFX/Spells/NS_Fireball. Not a filesystem path.

objectPath.description: Fully qualified object path including subobject, e.g. /Game/X/BP_Y.BP_Y_C:EventGraph.

contentHash.description: Algorithm-prefixed content hash of canonicalised state. Stable across cosmetic churn (node reordering, position jitter, GUID regeneration); sensitive to semantic change. Canonicalisation rules are WS-05's to specify (ADR-0006 open question).

revision.description: Opaque revision token for optimistic concurrency. Currently equal to contentHash; treat as opaque so the implementation can change.

mode.description: Collision and modification semantics. Behaviour table is frozen in ADR-0006. Auto-suffixing a name to avoid a collision is prohibited.

responseDetail.description: minimal: status + primary asset only. summary (default): change manifest, validation, metrics — must never contain raw Unreal object dumps. diagnostic: adds full diagnostics and execution trace. complete: adds full graph payloads.

revisionConflictPolicy.description: ADR-0006. Default reject: silent last-writer-wins is unacceptable with concurrent agents. 'merge' is not required for v1.

status.description: Reflects VERIFIED reality, never tool-call completion (AGENTS.md rule 6). An operation that could not verify returns partially_completed with a reason, never a *_validated status.

verificationTag.description: Confidence in an API/behaviour claim. See AGENTS.md rule 1.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code, e.g. graph.disconnected_subgraph, bp.compile_error, niagara.missing_renderer.

remediation.description: What the agent could do about it. Omit rather than guess.

role.description: Why this asset is in the list, e.g. 'projectile_effect', 'impact_material'.

changeEntry.description: One entry of the machine-readable change manifest. Derived from FGlobalSandbox::GetChanges(), not hand-maintained (ADR-0005 rule 4).

metrics.description: Mandatory on every response (ADR-0003 rule 3). Round-trip reduction is the project's headline success metric; an optional metric does not get measured.

mcp_round_trips.description: MCP calls the agent spent to achieve this result. Normally 1.

internal_operations.description: Primitive editor operations performed internally. The ratio to mcp_round_trips is the value this project delivers.

timing_ms.description: Phase timings, e.g. planning, asset_creation, compilation, validation, save.

replayed.description: True when this response was served from the idempotency store and no work was performed (ADR-0006).

linearColor.description: RGBA, linear space, unclamped (values may exceed 1.0 for HDR/emissive).
